_comment: The daily readings as the Orthodox Church in America publishes them: for each civil date on the New Calendar, the references in the calendar's own order, each with the calendar's own label (Epistle, Gospel, Matins Gospel, Vespers, Epistle and Gospel for a saint or feast). References and labels only. The words a reader sees are always from Purify's own public-domain Bible. A null label means that reading's label has not been collected, and lib/calendar/officialReadings.ts then does not use that day. A dated table, not a rule: it ends on its last day.
_source: https://www.oca.org/readings/daily/YYYY/MM/DD and each reading's own page under it. Collected 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11, one page per ten seconds as the site's robots.txt asks.
